cases.ordinary_exit_oracle: Guardian, worker and grandchild must exit zero on Windows using wait/query handles acquired while alive. POSIX unavailable non-child statuses remain null and provide no zero-exit credit.
cases.raw_evidence: Fresh guardian-crash-UUID under enclosing command directory when ACCEPTANCE_PROCESS_REGISTRY is present; tmp_path otherwise. Separate binary stdout/stderr for all four roles, identity registries, guardian JSONL/result, worker-result, actual observed exits and raw SHA256 manifest.
cases.cleanup: Bounded cooperative stop files; emergency cleanup only exact registered identities or exact owned Popen handles. All semantic assertions precede test-finally emergency cleanup. OS-created auxiliaries retain guardian-observed ancestry and must also be gone.
cases.interpreter_selection: Launch the OS-observed parent interpreter executable directly; preserve exact current psutil module path/hash via explicit child PYTHONPATH. No venv-redirector lifecycle credit.

remaining_gaps: Original experiment launcher actual child-crash lifecycle remains a separate D-T10 obligation.
This process negative control is not acceptance execution, independent verification, application E2E or measured/stress evidence.
Non-Windows unavailable non-child wait statuses must remain unknown until separately observed.
